thread:
eli: Heads-up: kicking off a 4-week integrator beta to validate Private onboarding flows + quantized model stability. Goal: recruit 69 integrators who will run a small proof (end-to-end) and give actionable feedback. Need screening rubric, outreach copy, and a minimal legal checklist.
tara: i'll own outreach + form. prefer targeted outreach (existing trial users) not cold lists. draft outreach: 'Interested in a short pilot to validate private infra + performance? 4 weeks, technical support, $2k credit + priority private rollout.' keep it short.
vik: screening rubric idea: must-haves (VPC or on-prem requirement, committed SE time, sample dataset ok to share); nice-to-haves (>=1M tokens/month, real-time use-case). redlines: no PHI, no regulated finance PII.
nora: legal checklist: NDA signed; data processing addendum if sharing customer data; clarify logging retention + audit access during pilot. for on-prem, require SOC2 checklist and remote support scope.	ops-bot: Provisioning reminder: pre-provisioned VPC peering templates available at /infra/vpc-templates. Use staging keys, rotate after pilot.
eli: outreach form fields (short): company, contact, use-case, concurrency/qps, avg seq len, infra preference (VPC/on-prem/hosted), willingness to share metrics, timeline, SE contact. tara pls make GForm + share.
tara: will make form. cadence proposal: week0: kickoff + infra prep; week1: ingest + smoke tests; week2: perf & quality checkpoint; week3: iteration on config (quant/profile changes); week4: final review + ROI + case study consent. daily async notes in shared doc.
vik: measurement: p95 latency, tokens/sec, model perplexity delta on safety prompts, quality pass-rate on seeded evals. add rollback triggers: p95 > 2x SLA for >30m or safety regression > baseline by 5%.
ora: security ask: provide KMS rotation steps, access scope, and confirm whether remote debug requires temporary elevated access. include opt-out for any debug steps.
sam: incentive tweak: $2k credits + 1 SE-hr/week + promo case study (opt-in). also offer post-pilot discount for reserved capacity.
eli: candidate prioritization matrix (quick): 1) onboarding effort (low/high), 2) impact/visibility (customer revenue & references), 3) technical fit. prioritize low-effort + high-impact.
tara: outreach message ready. i'll run a short shortlist by fri. eli, can you share candidate list and intro template?
eli: sharing list now. intro template: 'Hey <name>, we'd love to invite you to a short, supported pilot to validate Private deployment and perf tradeoffs. Expect 4 weeks, technical partnership, credits. If interested, fill this 2-min form.'
vik: also prepare a lightweight eval harness: 20 canonical prompts + 10 safety checks + perf runner (curl script). i'll drop scripts in the shared folder.
ora: add legal quick-signer (one-pager) to reduce friction. sam, coordinate incentives approval with finance.
sam: on it. finance ok with credits if pilot feedback pipeline is completed and case-study consent requested.
eli: owners: outreach/tara, screening/vik, infra gate/nora, incentives/sam, measurements/eli. next sync Tue 10am to approve shortlist. closing note: keep messages short during outreach to reduce friction.
